name: Aina
source:
Age: XX | LV 1 Reaper

Aina is a bubbly, kind girl who is willing to do anything if she believes it's for the best. Her kindness does not mean that she will take things lying down, however, and will speak her mind. She can and absolutely will be feral.

Despite her cleverness, she has a nature that allows her to be a little naive and too trusting at times.

LIKES
Bubble tea, drinks at Caym's, bread, board games, spending time with the others, making fun of Orias

DISLIKES
Timeshare schemes, the nobility, paperwork, people who look down on her, ghosts, technology
